# A heading that marks [ash]{#id-ash .index see="Oak"}

The fixture for cross-reference marks in the places where Typst copies or
drops a label (M119). Each mark gets a label of its own, and a label that a
table of contents or a list copies names two elements. Every mark carries an
author's id, and the last page links to each one. The term every
cross-reference names is marked here: [Oak]{#id-oak .index}.

Every case ends in an explicit page break, so the page each mark sits on is a
fact of this source: page 1 holds the contents and the lists, and each break
starts the next page. No term holds the letters `f` and `i`, `f` and `l`, two
`f`s, or two `!`s in a row, which the Typst floor sets as one glyph.
